text:
Priya (Revenue Ops): Heads up — launching price A/B for SV2 accounts starting Mon. Need to confirm how we handle capacity buffer credits for cohorts that overflow the dedicated buckets. Who owns the billing-side adjustments? :wave:
Omar (Billing): I can own the invoice-side. Two questions: 1) Do we apply automatic one-time credits or prorated over next invoice? 2) Do we record as 'experiment rebate' line item or adjust usage lines?
Sarah (Finance): +1 on Omar. Prefer single 'experiment rebate' line item for audit. Keep gross usage unchanged. Need GL code — use 5402? cc @Jun for meter signals.
Jun (Eng): We can emit a usage tag `experiment:cohort-AB2` and `overflow=true` to the metering pipeline. Example event:
```
{ "account_id": 1234, "tokens": 450000, "tags": ["experiment:AB2","overflow"] }
```
That makes it easier for billing rules to detect.
Omar (Billing): Perfect. For credits, I propose a two-step: record a negative line on same invoice for overage value capped at N credits, and also emit a CSV to finance for reconciliation. Priya — what's the credit cap per cohort?
Priya (Revenue Ops): We modeled two options in the sheet: cap per account of $200 vs. cohort-wide pool $5k. For conservative rollout let's start with per-account $150 cap and cohort pool $3k as fallback. We want to avoid giving unlimited credits during canary.
Emma (Sales): FYI some legacy enterprise customers expect grandfathering for preexisting committed rates. If overflow triggers and they hit credit cap we'll need to surface a manual approval path.
Sarah (Finance): Add an approval flag `manual_grandfather=true` to the billing export so AR can route it. Also require account owner in the CSV.
Omar (Billing): I'll update the billing rule. Draft pseudocode:
```
if tags contains "overflow":
  credit = min(usage_overage_value, account_cap || cohort_pool_remaining)
  invoice.add_negative_line("experiment_rebate", credit)
  log(export_csv_row)
```
Jun (Eng): ETA for tagging + export? I can push tagging and a toggle behind `feature/exp-AB2` today, and export by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (Revenue Ops): Sounds good. Action items: Omar to draft billing rule and sample invoice, Jun to push tags & export, Sarah to confirm GL code + approval workflow, Emma to flag accounts needing grandfathering.
LedgerBot: Billing export scheduled: /exports/billing/1892345678_ab2_overflow.csv (will contain headers account_id,owner,invoice_id,credit_amount,manual_grandfather)
Omar (Billing): I'll post the draft invoice template here when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
